component.name: Mouse Battery
component.summary: Show your Logitech mouse battery in the system tray

description.p: Mouse Battery puts the battery level of every connected Logitech mouse in the system tray, and warns once at 10% and once at 5% per charge.
It reads mice the kernel drives through UPower, and reads the PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE's receiver and cable over HID++. It isn't affiliated with Logitech.
